added_lines: hse information evening: tuesday 20th october in the killarney heights hotel, killarney . learn about fair deal, enduring power of attorney, sage advocacy, age friendly homes & more information stands from 7.30 p.m. and talk will begin at 8.00 p.m. parenting in a modern society: torc community & family resource centre will host a talk by john lonergan in teach íosagáin, rathmore on 4th november at 8.00 p.m. john is a highly respected speaker who served as governor of mountjoy prison for over 22 years and governor of portlaoise prison for almost four years. following his retirement in 2010, he published his autobiography, the governor , and later wrote parenting-raising your child in ireland today. everyone welcome. thought for the week: optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. nothing can be done without hope and confidence. (helen keller) world mission day this weekend we celebrate world mission day. this offers us an opportunity to show our love and to share what we can with those less fortunate than ourselves. we ask god to protect our missionaries as they spread god’s message. millstreet
